name: Aiyoku Mad Saimin
source:
Ayumi Miyashiro is a talented young sales manager at a pharmaceutical company.
However, regardless of her abilities, the company is experiencing financial difficulties.

The low salary and harsh working conditions make her want to run away from the company. That alone would make her want to run away from the work environment,
Even so, Ayumi cherishes her career, and with her pride, she uses her natural earnestness as a weapon,
She works hard every day.

But Ayumi's worries are endless. One of her subordinates, Shuichi Fujiwara, is the source of her stress.
It is her subordinate, Shuichi Fujiwara.
He is an insensitive man who incurs Ayumi's wrath by committing sexual harassment in any way he can.
He is also a poor subordinate whose sales performance is sluggish in terms of work.

--Then one day.
Ayumi is working overtime alone after taking medicine for a chronic illness.
She is busy cleaning up a sales mistake made by Shuichi.
Then Shuichi comes back to the office after finishing his sales rounds.
Ayumi's sermon time begins, and Shuichi's stress bursts out.
The stress of her daily life bursts out, and she starts to say a lot of harsh words to Shuichi.
Shuichi, as expected, is furious.
Ayumi! Eventually, your mind and body will be mine!
　If I want, you can show me your beautiful skin!　And then--! and other such obscene rhetoric that is difficult to publish here.

This statement became a hypnosis order, and ...... what a surprise!
In front of Shuichi, Ayumi starts to take off her clothes!
Shuichi, taking advantage of the situation, orders her to have sexual intercourse. Finally, under the irresistible force of compulsion, Shuichi is forced to have sexual intercourse with Ayumi!
From then on, Shuichi orders Ayumi to do whatever he wants to her.
Ayumi, on the other hand, is on the verge of insanity with no way to resist. ......

The next big case that will cause a sensation in the world, following the "Monstro-Romong Incident" of the lusty devil hypnotist, ...... now opens!

translation:
宫代步美是一家制药公司一位才华横溢的年轻销售经理。
然而，无论她的能力如何，公司都遇到了财务困难。

低廉的工资和恶劣的工作条件让她想逃离公司。光是这一点就让她想逃离工作环境，
即便如此，步美依然珍惜自己的事业，并以她的骄傲，用她天生的认真作为武器，
她每天都努力工作。

但步美的担忧却是无穷无尽的。她的下属之一藤原修一是她压力的根源。
是她的部下藤原修一。
他是一个麻木不仁的人，会不择手段地进行性骚扰，从而招致步美的愤怒。
从工作上来说，他也是一个销售业绩低迷的可怜下属。

——然后有一天。
亚由美因慢性病服药后独自加班。
她正忙着纠正修一犯下的销售错误。
然后修一结束销售工作回到办公室。
步美的布道时间开始，秀一的压力爆发了。
日常生活的压力突然爆发，她开始对秀一说很多严厉的话。
不出所料，秀一勃然大怒。
亚由美！最终，你的思想和身体将是我的！
　如果我愿意的话，你可以让我看看你美丽的皮肤！　进而 -！以及其他此类淫秽言论很难在这里发表。

这句话变成了催眠令，而且……真是惊喜啊！
当着修一的面，步美开始脱衣服了！
秀一趁机命令她发生性行为。最后，在不可抗拒的强迫力下，秀一被迫与步美发生性关系！
从那时起，修一命令步美对她做任何他想做的事。
而步美则处于疯狂的边缘，无法反抗。……

继猛男催眠师“怪物罗蒙事件”之后，下一个轰动世界的大案，……现在揭晓！
